newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange volume surges, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange volume surges, prices mixed.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange surged to 996 kilos on Monday from 210 kilos on Friday with banks engaging in arbitrage as gold eased in dollar terms and the dollar strengthened against the lira, dealers said.
Gold eased to $353.70 an ounce from $355.30 on Friday in line with world trends, but rose to 1,299,300 lira per gram from 1,295,000 as the lira weakened against the dollar.
The Turkish currency dived to 114,160 lira to the dollar, from 112,830 on Friday.
Banks usually make arbitrage deals by buying gold in dollars and selling in lira to benefit from falling gold prices and a rising dollar.

All but 10 kilos of the day's 996 kilos trade was conducted in the morning session as deals in the afternoon have to be settled on the following day. 52.8 percent of trade was conducted in lira terms.
